integrity: The self-map, its exact distance formula, and the zero-modulus conclusion are proved symbolically. The focal source was inspected through its full text for the definitions, primary classification, Hilbert strong-plasticity result, and the plasticity theorem for \(c\) and \(\ell_\infty\). No computation or finite search is used as proof.
limitations: The theorem assumes a linear isometric embedding of the max-sum \(\mathbb R\oplus_\infty X\) into \(X\); it does not classify spaces without that self-similarity and makes no assertion about \(S_{\ell_1}\). The principal originality risk is an equivalent elementary observation under different max-sum or metric-plasticity terminology.
title: Max-summand self-similarity forces zero strong-plasticity modulus
